events.title: Show us your base and win your own item in the game!
events.summary: Steam Next Fest is in full swing, and you have built amazing things in the demo. Now we want to see them! How to enter Record a short clip of your base in Bugs & Birdies (demo or full game) Post it in the #bugs-and-birdies channel on our Discord, together with your idea for a new item in the game Deadline: October 26, 7 pm CET (11 am PDT) Tip: Steam's built-in game recording is all you need to capture your clip. events.title: Bugs & Birdies now speaks 10 languages!
events.summary: Players from all over the world have put Bugs & Birdies on their wishlist, and many of you asked to play in your own language. From today the game speaks ten languages: English and German, and now also Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Russian, Japanese, Korean, French, Spanish and Turkish. events.title: Music Plates & the Fiddle Beetle
events.summary: Bugs & Birdies has a new way to play: music. Four new floor plates sound like a piano, a trumpet, a choir and a double bass whenever someone steps on them. Tap a plate to tune it a semitone higher, lay a few side by side and walk your melody across the farm. events.title: Four players, one farmstead: co-op is in
events.summary: Bugs & Birdies now has online co-op for up to four players. Open your world to friends through Steam, build together, split up to mine and fish, and hold the beetles off side by side when the swarms come at night. Friends who return later pick up right where they left off, backpack and all. And that is only part of it.
